categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen YHLO Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of chemiluminescence immunoassay instruments and reagents. The company also engages in the agency sales of foreign medical devices, including products from Beckman, Becton Dickinson, and Werfen, mainly within Guangdong Province. Its product portfolio covers immunodiagnostics, biochemical diagnostics, molecular diagnostics, and related medical instruments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include magnetic particle acridinium ester chemiluminescence immunoassay, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), immunoblotting, colloidal gold chromatography, indirect immunofluorescence, and biochemical diagnostics. It has developed a comprehensive chemiluminescence platform with proprietary intellectual property, including patented technologies in instruments, reagents, magnetic beads, and labeling. Production follows strict quality management systems compliant with ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and CE standards, with a sales-driven production model ensuring quality and timely delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: YHLO serves primarily domestic and international medical institutions, including over 5,980 domestic hospitals with a strong presence in tertiary and tertiary A-level hospitals covering over 69% of such hospitals nationwide. Its products are used in clinical laboratories, third-party testing centers, and smaller hospitals. The company’s overseas markets span over 110 countries across the Americas, Europe, Asia, and Africa, targeting clinical diagnostic labs and healthcare providers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Shenzhen and other locations including Hunan, Shanghai, and Nanjing. It has expanded its overseas footprint to cover more than 110 countries and regions globally, including the Americas, Europe, Asia, and Africa. It has established local service offices and training centers in Southeast Asia, Latin America, and other regions to support its international business.
categories.supply_chain_position: YHLO operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IVD supply chain. It develops and manufactures diagnostic instruments and reagents (midstream) and sells these products directly or through distributors to hospitals and laboratories (downstream). The company also procures key raw materials such as antigens and antibodies, with ongoing efforts to increase self-production of these upstream materials to reduce dependency on external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in chemiluminescence immunoassay technology and expanding its diagnostic product menu, especially in autoimmune diseases, reproductive health, liver diseases, diabetes, and infectious diseases. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 16.8% revenue allocation in 2024, focusing on developing new instruments, reagents, microfluidic platforms, molecular diagnostics, and gene sequencing technologies. YHLO also prioritizes localization of raw material production, AI-enabled development of biological reagents, and automation solutions such as intelligent laboratory automation lines.
categories.revenue_model: YHLO generates revenue primarily through the sales of self-developed IVD instruments and reagents, including chemiluminescence analyzers and diagnostic kits. It also earns revenue from agency sales of foreign medical devices and related consumables. The company employs a mixed sales model with direct sales to key customers and distributor-based sales domestically and internationally. Additional revenue streams include software services for laboratory information management systems.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: YHLO is positioned as a leading domestic provider of chemiluminescence-based IVD products in China, competing with international giants such as Roche, Abbott, Beckman Coulter, and Siemens. It has broken foreign monopolies in certain diagnostic segments and is recognized as one of the top domestic brands in autoimmune and reproductive health diagnostics. The company faces competition from both multinational corporations and emerging domestic players but leverages its technology platforms, product breadth, and strong hospital penetration to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, YHLO reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.01 billion, a slight decrease of 2.02% compared to 2023, mainly due to a decline in COVID-19 related business. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 301.5 million, down 15.06% year-over-year. However, net profit excluding non-recurring items grew by 30.84%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 4.42 billion, up 16%, with net assets of RMB 2.76 billion, reflecting steady growth and expansion in R&D and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: YHLO differentiates itself through its proprietary magnetic particle acridinium ester chemiluminescence technology platform, offering high sensitivity, specificity, and automation capabilities. It provides a comprehensive diagnostic menu with over 178 registered chemiluminescence diagnostic projects, including leading products in autoimmune diseases and reproductive health. The company emphasizes product quality, stable performance, and extensive clinical validation, supported by strong academic collaborations and a broad hospital network, positioning itself as a trusted domestic brand with international competitiveness.
